concept.hr: Poredak okteta u memoriji i na žici
concept.en: Byte order in memory and on the wire

summary.hr: Upiši vrijednost i pročitaj je kao oktete: big-endian i little-endian memorija, mrežni poredak na žici i što program dobije bez ntohl.
summary.en: Write a value and read it as bytes: big-endian and little-endian memory, network byte order on the wire, and what a program gets without ntohl.
